login_screen.style: Industrial splitscreen or dark backdrop with high-tech grid texture, company logo switcher, username + password input ONLY (no email requirement), multi-company selector

features: Company switcher with active dynamic logo
User badge with role permission level
Columns by Status (Planejado, Em andamento, Em validação, Com pendências, Concluído, Cancelado)
Drag & Drop or direct status switcher
Dual upload mode: Ponto de Corte + Coleta Física
Data validation preview with line-by-line error highlighting

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure language is strict Portuguese (pt-BR) throughout all screens, labels, status badges, buttons, tooltips, and toast messages.
Implement full mock/REST backend interactions for login (username/password), multi-company switching, permissions matrix, and inventory operations.
Ensure every interactive element and key metric display includes a descriptive kebab-case data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='inventory-status-badge', data-testid='excel-export-button').
Implement Excel import with live drag & drop file upload, tabular preview, validation error highlights, and validation engine metrics calculation.
Ensure the status badges strictly match the 6 specified states: Planejado, Em andamento, Em validação, Com pendências, Concluído, Cancelado.
Provide responsive views for desktop (primary) and tablet industrial screens.
Use Recharts for interactive bar, pie, and divergence trend charts in the Inventário Dashboard.
Provide PDF report generation preview and download simulator with clean printable layout.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_slop_rule: Avoid generic centered white cards with default shadows. Use dense industrial headers, high-contrast monospace table cells, sharp 1px borders, subtle slate glowing active states, and crisp typography.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_rule: All buttons, inputs, links, tabs, tables, tooltips, modals, and KPI cards MUST have data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.accessibility: Ensure text contrast passes WCAG AA and hover states explicitly update text color alongside background changes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toast_notifications: Use sonner for user alerts (e.g., 'Empresa cadastrada com sucesso', 'Relatório PDF gerado', 'Inventário atualizado').
